title: Workspace default_artifact_root must be a URI or an absolute path
answers: workspace artifacts logged to my local directory instead of the server
relative default artifact root rejected when creating a workspace
create or update workspace default_artifact_root validation
experiments in a workspace have artifact location with no scheme
body:
Symptom: a workspace saved with a relative default_artifact_root such as 'team-a' is accepted, but experiments in it log artifacts to the client's current directory. The artifact browser stays empty and no error is raised.
Root cause: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_workspace_default_artifact_root delegated only to _validate_optional_workspace_storage_location, which checks fragments, runs:/ URIs and length but not scheme or absoluteness. SqlAlchemyWorkspaceStore persists the value and resolve_artifact_root returns it unchanged.
Fix pattern: in the default_artifact_root wrapper, after the shared helper, raise MlflowException.invalid_parameter_value when get_uri_scheme(value) is empty and os.path.isabs(value) is false. The message reads "Expected a URI (for example 's3://bucket/prefix' or 'mlflow-artifacts:/prefix') or an absolute path".
Constraints: None, '' and whitespace keep their current meaning (no override / clear the override). Absolute local paths stay valid, mirroring the server-level --default-artifact-root. Keep the check in the wrapper, not the shared helper, so the trace_archival_config.location error text and experiment artifact_location are unchanged. get_uri_scheme treats single-letter schemes such as 'C:team-a' and 'a:b' as local paths, so those are rejected too.
Applies: Workspace create and update validation of default_artifact_root in mlflow/server/handlers.py; not experiment-level artifact_location.
applies: Workspace create and update validation of default_artifact_root in mlflow/server/handlers.py; does not change experiment-level artifact_location.
says: Experiment artifacts are saved to my local machine instead of the workspace storage.
The artifact browser stays empty after logging outputs from runs in our workspace.
Reject relative folder paths when configuring the default storage location for a workspace.
Require a complete storage destination or full cloud bucket link when creating workspaces.
search: Validation of default_artifact_root during workspace creation and updates in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_workspace_default_artifact_root requires either a URI with a scheme or an absolute path. Saving relative paths causes experiments to log files to the client's current directory leaving the artifact browser empty, so MlflowException.invalid_parameter_value is raised when get_uri_scheme is empty and os.path.isabs is false. The check belongs in the default_artifact_root wrapper rather than _validate_optional_workspace_storage_location to avoid altering experiment-level artifact_location or trace_archival_config.location error messages. Empty strings, None, and whitespace remain valid to represent no override, while single-letter prefixes like C:team-a are treated as relative local paths and rejected.
